name: Gemini Omni Flash
description: High-performance model for fast, conversational video generation and editing over the Interactions API. Turns text and images into video, refines results through natural-language conversation, and adds video extension, first-plus-last-frame interpolation, and 360p to 4K resolution control.

sources.title: Gemini Omni Flash model page
sources.notes: Stable model code, supported data types, and the 1,048,576 token context window. Output video is 3-10s at 360p/720p/1080p/4K, 24 FPS, which is not a token budget.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: Standard tier: $1.50 input, $9.00 text output, $17.50 video output per 1M tokens. Only the text output price is recorded here.
